schema.text: the message/transcript to paste into Kavach — kept messy/real-world on purpose
schema.expectedNextAskedFor: plain-language description of what the sender wants, or null
schema.isHardNegative: true if this is a legitimate message deliberately designed to resemble a scam

testCases.text: Dear Customer, aapka SBI a/c KYC ke wajah se 24 ghante mein BLOCK ho jayega. Turant update karein: sbi-kyc-verify.in warna a/c permanently band ho jayega.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: clicking an unofficial KYC link and entering account details

testCases.text: HDFC BANK ALERT: Suspicious txn of Rs 45,000 detected on ur a/c. If not done by you call our helpline immediately +91-9XXXX-XXXXX to block card & report fraud.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: a callback to an unofficial number

testCases.text: ICICI Bank: Ur account has been temporarily FROZEN due to unusual activity. Verify your identity now to unfreeze: icici-verify-secure.com/unlock
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: personal/account details entered on an unofficial site

testCases.text: AXIS BANK SECURITY DEPT: Your debit card ending 3321 has been BLOCKED as a precaution. To reactivate share the OTP that will be sent shortly. Ref: AXBK992211
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP code

testCases.text: Canara Bank: Your PAN is not linked with Aadhaar as per RBI norms. Account will be restricted from tomorrow. Link now: canara-panlink.net
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: PAN/Aadhaar details entered on an unofficial site

testCases.text: Kotak Mahindra: Ur 4,500 reward pts expiring TODAY!! Redeem now before midnight or lose them permanently, click: kotak-rewards-redeem.info
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: clicking an unofficial rewards link

testCases.text: Good afternoon sir/madam, I am calling from your bank's Security Department, employee ID 4471. We have flagged your account for a compliance review, I need to verify a few details with you right now to prevent a hold being placed.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: verbal confirmation of personal/account details

testCases.text: Sir aapke Aadhaar number se ek parcel mein illegal drugs pakde gaye hain, ye ek cybercrime case hai. Aapko abhi digital arrest kiya ja raha hai, camera on rakhiye aur officer se disconnect mat kijiye jab tak verification complete na ho.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: staying on a fake video call and following the caller's instructions

testCases.text: INCOME TAX DEPT NOTICE: Discrepancy found in your ITR filing. Pay pending dues of Rs 8,400 within 3 hours to avoid arrest warrant. Pay here: it-dept-duespay.in
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an immediate payment via an unofficial link

testCases.text: COURT NOTICE: You have failed to appear for hearing on case #CR2026/4471. Non-appearance warrant will be issued in 24 hrs. Contact clerk immediately: +91-8XXXX-XXXXX
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an urgent callback to resolve a fake legal case

testCases.text: UIDAI ALERT: Your Aadhaar will be SUSPENDED in 6 hours due to biometric mismatch. Re-verify immediately at aadhaar-reverify-now.in to avoid loss of all linked services.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: Aadhaar details entered on an unofficial site

testCases.text: URGENT: Your SIM will be DEACTIVATED in 2 hours as your document verification is pending. Update immediately by sharing OTP with our agent on call +91-7XXXX-XXXXX
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP shared with a caller

testCases.text: Passport Seva: Your passport renewal application is on HOLD. Fee of Rs 1,500 must be paid within 12 hours or application will be cancelled permanently. Pay: passportseva-fees.online
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an urgent payment via an unofficial link

testCases.text: Your LIC policy no. 9922XXXX lapses TODAY! Pay premium of Rs 3,200 now to avoid losing 8 years of coverage: licindia-premiumpay.net
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an urgent premium payment via an unofficial link

testCases.text: Sir this is Priya from your bank's customer care, we're processing your refund of Rs 2,340 right now. To confirm it's really you, please read out the 6-digit OTP that just came to your phone.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP code read aloud

testCases.text: Amazon Refunds: Your refund of Rs 1,999 is ready! Share the OTP received on your phone with our support agent to complete instant refund processing.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP code

testCases.text: BlueDart Courier: Your parcel delivery failed. Share the OTP sent to your number with our delivery executive to reschedule today itself.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP code

testCases.text: Hello, this is Airtel verification team, your SIM will be blocked for non-compliance. Please tell me the OTP that has been sent to your registered number to complete re-verification.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP code

testCases.text: Sir I am from customer care, I can see your card block complaint. To resolve it right now, please share the OTP you just received so I can reverse the block.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP code

testCases.text: Congrats! 5000 credit card reward points ready to redeem. Share OTP with executive on call to instantly convert points to cashback before offer expires tonight.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP code

testCases.text: Ma'am your UPI PIN needs to be reset for security purposes. Please share the OTP on your screen so our system can generate a new PIN for you safely.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: the OTP code

testCases.text: Sir aapka refund ₹1,499 pending hai, isse claim karne ke liye humein pehle ₹10 verification charge UPI se bhejna hoga is QR code par, tabhi refund release hoga.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: a small UPI payment before an alleged refund

testCases.text: You've WON a Samsung smartphone worth Rs 45,000 in our anniversary draw! Pay Rs 199 delivery charge via UPI to this ID: rewardsclaim@okaxis to receive your prize.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: a UPI payment before an alleged prize is delivered

testCases.text: Hi, this is regarding invoice #INV-7734 for services rendered. Kindly clear the pending amount of Rs 6,500 immediately via UPI to avoid late penalty: vendorpay@upi
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an urgent UPI payment for an unverified invoice

testCases.text: BESCOM: Your electricity will be DISCONNECTED tonight. Pending bill Rs 1,340 must be paid NOW via UPI, scan attached QR to avoid disconnection.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an urgent UPI payment via a QR code

testCases.text: This is traffic police cyber cell, a challan of Rs 2,000 is pending against your vehicle for a traffic violation. Pay immediately via UPI to avoid your license being suspended.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an urgent UPI payment for an unverified fine

testCases.text: Your parcel is held at the local hub due to unpaid handling fee of Rs 49. Pay now via UPI to release for delivery today: courierfee@upi, else parcel returned tomorrow.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: a small UPI payment to release a parcel

testCases.text: Mumma mera phone kho gaya hai, ye mera dost ka number hai. Mujhe abhi ₹15,000 chahiye emergency mein, is UPI ID pe bhej do, papa ko abhi mat batana main baad mein sab explain karunga.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an urgent UPI payment kept secret from family

testCases.text: Welcome to our exclusive trading circle! Please don't discuss the strategies or your profits with anyone outside this group, including family — it dilutes our edge and could get the group shut down.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: joining and keeping an investment scheme secret

testCases.text: Ma'am please do not call your bank's helpline to verify this, sometimes their system shows a false alarm and it can delay your refund by weeks. Just follow my instructions and it'll be sorted in 5 minutes.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: avoiding independent verification and following the caller's instructions

testCases.text: You've been shortlisted for a confidential brand-ambassador role, salary Rs 40,000/month. Please keep this offer strictly private and don't mention it to other applicants until you sign the agreement.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: keeping a job offer secret while moving toward payment or personal info

testCases.text: To secure your account right now, please download AnyDesk from the Play Store, open it, and read out the 9-digit code shown on your screen so I can access your device and fix this for you.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: installing a remote-access app and sharing its access code

testCases.text: For processing your refund faster, please install TeamViewer QuickSupport, it takes 30 seconds. Once installed just tell me the ID number on your screen.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: installing a remote-access app and sharing its ID

testCases.text: Your KYC verification is pending. Download 'Quick Support' app from this link and share the access code with our verification agent to complete it in 2 minutes: bit.ly/kyc-verify-app
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: installing a screen-share app and sharing its access code

testCases.text: Sir your phone has a virus that's stealing your bank data. Download this cleaner app I'm sending you right now and let me guide you through removing it before it's too late.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: installing an unverified app and following the caller's remote instructions

testCases.text: Ghar baithe data entry job, ₹1500/din guaranteed. Bas ₹499 registration fee bhejo aur aaj hi start karo, seats limited hain.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an upfront registration fee for a job

testCases.text: Join our crypto trading group, guaranteed 20% returns weekly, no risk. Our expert signals have never failed. Start with just Rs 5,000 and double it in 10 days.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an investment payment based on guaranteed-return claims

testCases.text: You're selected as an Amazon product reviewer, earn Rs 500 per review. A refundable security deposit of Rs 2,000 is required before you can start receiving tasks.
testCases.expectedNextAskedFor: an upfront security deposit for a job
